name: io.github.flashdata-dev/google-search
title: Google Search — FlashData
description: Google Search rankings, URLs and snippets for localized SERP research. Paid FlashData API.

environmentVariables.name: FLASHDATA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FlashData API Key with google_search access. Get a key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys; data calls are paid.

dev.flashdata.task: Export Google Search SERP rankings with source URLs
dev.flashdata.useResult: Read results[0].organic; retain position, title, link and snippet together with created_at. Save separate snapshots before comparing rankings.
dev.flashdata.limits: One page is one query. Ranking depends on query and location; actual result count may be lower than requested. Search snippets are not article full text.
dev.flashdata.installation: Local MCPB / stdio; Node.js >=22.18.0; set your own FLASHDATA_API_KEY in protected client settings. See guideUrl for manual setup.
dev.flashdata.billing: MIT software and installation are free. FlashData data calls use paid Credits. Pricing/job/result reads are free; client and model fees are separate.
